cause_quote: The diff added `"update.run"` to `GATEWAY_ACTIONS` while retaining `profiles: []` on the `gateway` catalog entry, which excluded the tool from all limited profiles.
user_saw: Owners using a default limited tool profile could not start an update by asking the agent in ordinary chat.
summary: The fix exposed `gateway.update.run` to limited profiles, enforced chat authorization in the shared handler, and removed the English phrase shortcut.
reasoning: I checked the restoration diff and its profile allowlist logic, which excluded `gateway` from minimal, coding, and messaging when the owner-gated action shipped. The earlier version of the tool also had `profiles: []` before its update action was removed, so there was no earlier working path through those profiles. PR #145527 added a pre-model `/update` confirmation as a workaround and left the tool grants unchanged.
